settings.title: Settings

chatSuggestions.label: Chat Suggestions
chatSuggestions.description: Display AI-generated conversation starters in the chat interface

flashAttention.label: Flash Attention
flashAttention.description: Enables OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1 for improved memory efficiency. Disable if you experience instability. Takes effect after reinstalling the AI Assistant.

autoThinking.label: Use thinking automatically when a model supports it
autoThinking.description: Sets the default for models that can think. You can still turn thinking on or off for an individual model in the chat window.

rag.label: Knowledge Base Retrieval
rag.description: Search your knowledge base for relevant documents before answering. Turn this off to save memory and speed up replies when your knowledge base is small or empty. This is the same switch as the one in the chat window.

assistantName.label: Assistant Name
assistantName.help: Give your AI assistant a custom name that will be used in the chat interface and other areas of the application.

tasksModel.label: Tasks Model
tasksModel.help: Small, fast model used for background work like chat titles and suggestions. Leave this set to the chat model to use whichever model the chat is using. Avoid reasoning models here — they are slow at short, aesthetic tasks.

minRelevance.label: Knowledge Base Relevance
minRelevance.help: How closely a knowledge-base passage has to match your question before it is used in an answer. Stricter settings keep unrelated passages out; too strict and genuinely useful ones get dropped too. When nothing clears the bar, the assistant answers from its own knowledge instead.

relevanceCheck.label: Double-check knowledge base matches
relevanceCheck.description: Before answering, ask the Tasks Model whether the passages found are actually about your question, and leave them out (and uncited) when they are not. Helps most with large libraries like Wikipedia or Project Gutenberg, where something always looks similar. Needs a capable Tasks Model (about 8B parameters or larger); smaller models reject too many good matches. Adds a short delay to every reply.

responseStyle.label: Response Style
responseStyle.help: How adventurous the assistant is when picking its next word. Auto follows whatever the model's author recommended and fills in the rest, and suits most people. Focused gives shorter, steadier, more repeatable answers and is the better choice for looking things up. Creative varies its wording more, at some cost to accuracy.

contextWindow.label: Context Window
contextWindow.help: How much conversation and knowledge-base context each reply can consider. Auto sizes this per model from its trained limit and your available memory. Choosing a value sets an upper limit — it can lower the window to save memory, but never raises it beyond what a model supports.

settings.currentlyInEffect: Currently in effect: {{list}}. Changes take effect for new conversations.

installed.title: Installed Models
installed.empty: No models installed. Browse the model catalog below to get started.

remote.title: Remote Connection
remote.intro: Connect to any OpenAI-compatible API server — Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, and others are all supported. For remote Ollama instances, the host must be started with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0.
remote.urlPlaceholder: http://192.168.1.100:11434  (or :1234 for OpenAI API Compatible Apps)

catalog.title: Models
catalog.ollamaOnlyTitle: Model downloading is only supported when using a Ollama backend.
catalog.ollamaOnlyMessage: If you are connected to an OpenAI API host (e.g. LM Studio), please download models directly in that application.

cancelModal.title: Cancel Download?
cancelModal.question: Stop downloading <model>{{model}}</model>?
cancelModal.note: Any data already downloaded will remain on disk. If you re-download this model later, it will resume from where it left off rather than starting over.
